text:
jess-sales: Starting HelixCare POC thread. Customer needs SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM for 10k users with nested groups, RBAC mapping, domain locking (multiple domains), and clear cost delta between a small Dedicated pool and a Private deployment. Also asked about BAA/HIPAA controls.

omar-se: I'll own the technical runbook. Quick answers up front: SCIM supports full import + incremental (delta) events; nested groups are flattened by default but we can preserve hierarchy if they request group.path attributes. For large orgs we recommend initial bulk via CSV import endpoint then enable delta.

vivek-eng: SCIM rate limits: default 500 reqs/min for hosted; Dedicated POC we can increase to 2000 reqs/min for the window. Sample SCIM import curl: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/imports" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@users.csv
```

tina-sec: Security items: we can sign a BAA for HIPAA controls; for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS backed by HSM (by request). Audit logs: default 90-day retention for hosted, configurable for Dedicated/Private. For the security questionnaire, ping me the PDF and I'll take the sensitive encrypt/keys sections.

jess-sales: Customer question: SAML audience constraints and multi-domain ACS. They will have two domains (helixtwo.com + helixcare.io). Can we host both under one tenant?

omar-se: Yes. We support multiple Audience/ACS entries per SP. You can upload a single IdP metadata blob or multiple IdP configs. We recommend unique NameIDFormat per domain if they use different identifiers. Example attribute remap: `{'email':'email','groups':'memberOf','preferred_username':'username'}`.

vivek-eng: Deprovisioning specifics: SCIM delete = immediate removal from our auth index, but data retention varies by product: embeddings blobs and logs require explicit wipe in Private; hosted has 30-day soft-delete graveyard for accounts unless customer requests immediate purge (requires DSR form + legal approval).

tina-sec: Compliance blocker to flag: HelixCare wants per-request provenance for PHI-level data. That pushes us to Private with VPC peering and KMS. Dedicated can meet many controls but cross-tenant storage still exists. Recommend Private for full data residency + isolation.

jess-sales: Pricing ask: they want a midpoint estimate to present internally (finance team). Can we provide ballpark numbers now?

omar-se: Ballpark only: Dedicated POC (small pool, 1-2 GPUs, reserved for 6 weeks) =~ $9k-$11k/mo prorated; Private POC (on-prem/VPC deployment) = ~$120k one-time infra + $8k/mo support for the trial (infra variance large). I'll get exact quote from pricing-ops.

vivek-eng: Operational notes: if they need per-token tracing + 7d retention at sub-second granularity we need observability add-on (costed separately). Also SCIM delta retention/logging default 30d; we can export delta events to customer S3 in Private.

poc-bot: <https://docs.redwood.example.com/saml|SAML guide> · <https://docs.redwood.example.com/scim|SCIM guide> · <https://console.redwood.example.com/presales|Presales POC template>

jess-sales: Runbook proposal (6 weeks): week0 kickoff & legal (BAA/DSR), week1 domain proofing & SAML config, week2 SCIM bulk import + delta test, week3 RBAC mapping + nested group validation, week4 audit + observability checks, week5 cutover rehearsal + smoke, week6 wrap + exec demo.

tina-sec: I'll review BAA and the security questionnaire during week0. If they insist on HSM-backed KMS we'll need infra lead signoff; start that line item now.

omar-se: Action items: (1) Jess - send the security questionnaire PDF; (2) Vivek - confirm feasibility for nested-group path preservation and export sample mapping; (3) Omar - request rate limit bump from infra for dedicated POC window; (4) Pricing-ops - supply formal quote.

jess-sales: Done. Uploaded questionnaire to the thread and added HelixCare contact details. Scheduling kickoff Thurs 10am PT.

vivek-eng: I'll prepare a short demo showing nested groups -> roles mapping and a revoke flow.

tina-sec: I'll draft security answers and flag any non-standard asks.

jess-sales: Thanks team. I'll update CRM and share the kickoff invite. Will post quote when pricing-ops replies.

omar-se: Leaving this thread open for runbook + quote updates. Ping @tina-sec for the questionnaire review.

jess-sales: Closing loop for now — next update after Thursday kickoff.
